zh-CN.name: 信息架构
zh-CN.description: 用符合用户任务的分组、命名与层级组织内容，让人知道自己在哪里、下一步能去哪里。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按用户任务组织内容，提供清晰分类、当前位置与可预测导航；在信息量较大时提供搜索与目录等多种查找方式。
专属演示：真实分组导航、层级目录与路径，进入分类和返回更新同一内容区。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Information Architecture
en.description: Organize content with task-based labels, groups, and hierarchy so users know where they are and where to go.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Organize content by user tasks with clear categories, location cues, and predictable navigation. For larger collections, provide multiple ways to find content, such as search and a directory.
Dedicated demonstration: Grouped navigation, a hierarchy and a path; entering and returning changes the same content area. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
概念或实现参考，未复制外部正文与组件代码。
